comment: Host model policy: each intelligence tier resolves to a host-native model id per harness. Roster roles declare tiers only; explicit model choices live here, never in role or skill sources. Sage and Oracle run frontier-judgment (Opus on Claude Code, Sol on Codex); Sentry runs mechanical-cheap (Haiku on Claude Code, Luna on Codex). Council seats run deliberation across three CLIs in every run (Fable 5.1 via Claude CLI, Astra 6 via Codex CLI, Muse Wonder full via Muse CLI); an explicit human reviewer override may select another available model, including Fable or Astra.
